verdict.rationale: Apify offers anti-blocking proxy rotation, an MCP server for LLM/agent consumption, and llms.txt documentation support, suggesting some LLM-ready output orientation, but the evidence never explicitly documents a 'clean text/markdown extraction' output mode analogous to dedicated LLM-ready scraping tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic HTML-to-clean-text/markdown conversion output format, examples of LLM-ready output from Actors, and independent verification that scraped output is directly consumable without further parsing.
